class.name: yahboom_ros2_control/YahboomSystem
class.description: ros2_control SystemInterface for Yahboom ROSMASTER X3PLUS (STM32 motor controller + bus servo arm + IMU + push-mode encoder/IMU reports). D1: scaffold + protocol layer + serial wrapper. read()/write() are no-ops; chassis and arm wiring come in D2-D4.
